content.value_statement: Email teams need clear evidence of where messages land after a campaign. This skill turns exported placement and reputation telemetry into a provider-level trend report.
actual_capabilities: Reads inbox, spam, and promotions results for Gmail, Microsoft, Yahoo, and Apple seed inboxes.
Summarizes Gmail Postmaster domain and IP reputation, spam rate, and feedback-loop signals.
Summarizes Microsoft SNDS IP status, complaint rate, and spam-trap indicators.
Compares current placement data with a prior send baseline and names measured regressions.
Labels results as Measured, User-provided, or Estimated and identifies missing provider data.
limitations: It analyzes only telemetry supplied from user-owned exports or manual seed checks.
It cannot verify placement without provider-specific seed-test results.
It does not perform SPF, DKIM, or DMARC pre-flight validation.
It does not calculate a complete email quality score or make automatic sending decisions.

use_cases.title: Review a campaign placement drop
use_cases.description: Compare the latest seed-list results with a previous campaign and identify the providers that regressed.

use_cases.title: Track sender reputation trends
use_cases.description: Summarize Postmaster and SNDS exports to monitor domain and IP reputation across sends.

use_cases.title: Prepare a deliverability handoff
use_cases.description: Create a labeled placement snapshot for a reviewer before the next campaign decision.

prompt_templates.title: Check one campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this seed-list placement result for my sending domain. Show inbox, spam, and promotions placement by provider.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two sends
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these current and prior seed-test results. Name every provider regression and its percentage-point change.

prompt_templates.title: Add reputation data
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this seed-list test with my Gmail Postmaster and Microsoft SNDS exports. Separate measured facts from estimates.

prompt_templates.title: Create a full placement snapshot
prompt_templates.prompt: For this promotional campaign, create a SEND-S placement snapshot from the seed test, Postmaster export, SNDS export, and prior baseline. Flag missing inputs.

output_examples.input: Compare the latest Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, and Apple seed results with the previous send.
output: Yahoo inbox placement declined from 96% to 71%, a 25-point regression.
Gmail and Outlook remained stable. Apple data is missing and marked NEEDS_INPUT.

output_examples.input: Review this Postmaster and SNDS export with my seed-list results.
output: Gmail domain reputation changed from High to Medium while spam rate increased from 0.08% to 0.14%.
Microsoft IP status remains green. The report labels supplied values as User-provided.

best_practices: Provide a seed test for each mailbox provider you want to assess.
Keep a prior send baseline so the skill can measure meaningful changes.
Use exports from accounts you control and verify reported values before acting.
anti_patterns: Do not treat missing provider data as successful inbox placement.
Do not present inferred placement rates as measured results.
Do not use this skill as a replacement for authentication pre-flight checks.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide seed-list placement results and, when available, Gmail Postmaster, Microsoft SNDS, and prior-send exports.

faq.question: Does it send emails automatically?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes supplied data. The documented optional seed-send helper requires an explicit live command.

faq.question: Can it assess every mailbox provider?
faq.answer: It can report Gmail, Microsoft, Yahoo, and Apple results when those providers appear in your seed test.

faq.question: What happens when a provider is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks that provider as NEEDS_INPUT instead of assuming successful delivery.

faq.question: Does it validate SPF, DKIM, and DMARC?
faq.answer: No. Use the related deliverability pre-flight skill for authentication validation.

faq.question: Can it calculate my overall email quality score?
faq.answer: No. It produces a placement snapshot for a separate quality audit or sending decision.
